_comment: The issue-3 evasion, as a real hook payload. Every keyword is decorated with a non-ASCII letter at its boundary — the shape that made Python's \b stop anchoring. Under the pre-fix patterns only 'high-severity' matched: one family out of five, score far below the verify threshold. Under the boundary policy it scores 0.88 and stops. Used by tests/test_hook_enforce.py to prove the class is closed at the system layer, not just in the assessor.
